meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: Claude 用 DuckDB、Polars 等引擎分析你的 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据,做分组、连接、聚合、清洗,并按需画图。动手前先探测文件大小,决定数据读入内存、原地查询还是发往远端。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据,或做分组、聚合、清洗、绘图等操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个 CSV,按城市分组统计销售额
say.note: 先探测文件大小,再决定读入内存或原地查询

say.text: 这份 parquet 超过内存了,帮我原地流式算出每日订单数
say.note: 超内存时走流式或落盘,不整个加载

say.text: 把这个 JSON 里近一年的销量画成折线图
say.note: 绘图前会按可视化规范做视觉检查

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your CSV, Parquet and JSON data with DuckDB, Polars and similar engines: grouping, joins, aggregation, cleaning, charts. It probes file size first, then chooses in-memory, in-place, or remote execution.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze CSV, Parquet or JSON data, or to group, aggregate, clean or plot a dataset.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV and total sales grouped by city
say_en.note: Probes file size, then loads or queries in place

say_en.text: This parquet exceeds RAM — stream daily order counts in place
say_en.note: Streams or spills instead of loading the whole file

say_en.text: Chart last year's sales from this JSON as a line chart
say_en.note: Runs a visual QA pass on the chart
